title: HuntCandidate
description: One look-alike domain found by the Sentinel hunt mode (docs/design/HUNTER.md section 4). The hunt finds, the Investigator arbiter decides: status `confirmed` only means the arbiter said suspicious or dangerous. prescore is a queue priority, never a risk score. The live domain name is stored only in Postgres; every projection carries the defanged name and its sha256.

domain_defanged.description: Registrable domain, defanged (`[.]`); never a live name.

domain_sha256.description: sha256 of the lowercase A-label registrable domain.

first_seen.description: When the hunt first saw this candidate.

upstream_seen.description: Earliest certificate not_before from crt.sh, when known (crt.sh JSON rows carry no log-entry timestamp).

prescore.description: Queue priority only (operator view). Never a risk score; never reaches the arbiter.

time_to_detection_s.description: Arbiter verdict time minus the earliest upstream timestamp held (certificate not_before or RDAP registration date); null when no basis is known.

time_to_detection_basis.description: Optional. Which upstream timestamp time_to_detection_s is measured from; the UI names it next to the figure.
